method: Generated with built-in image generation, using approved gameplay art as visual references. Selected transparent outputs stored as lossless WebP. Runtime packing: scripts/pack_attack_art.py.

tasks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 8-frame game spritesheet. Generate FROM SCRATCH a new HIGH REARING STRIKE animation of the EXACT same cute tan-and-brown spotted coiled snake in reference 1 and 2. References establish identity/material only. Match rounded hand-modelled clay volumes, warm tan body, large expressive black eyes, brown round spots, soft upper-left light. EXACT canvas 1536x768, FOUR columns TWO rows, eight equal 384x384 cells, no lines or labels. One complete snake per cell; identical coiled base centered x192 and grounded at y352 in EACH cell, same fixed camera/scale. Snake faces LEFT in EVERY frame. Read left to right then next row: frame0 resting coil, frame1 draw neck into tall S, frame2 tense upright neck, frame3 tall anticipatory rear, frame4 extend head upwards and slightly left mouth open, frame5 peak upward-left strike mouth open with exactly one forked tongue, frame6 closed-mouth neck descending, frame7 back to initial rest. Keep base coils anchored; ONLY neck/head articulation changes. High strike must be clearly different from reference frontal strike. Single head, continuous neck, one coiled body, one tail, no duplicate anatomy or detached bits. Every complete pose contained within x20..364 y14..352 of its cell with transparent gutters. Transparent background, NO floor/shadow plane, NO checkerboard painted into output, no text, no stars, no speed trails. All cells use identical body size and consistent identity.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 8-frame game spritesheet. Generate FROM SCRATCH a LOW SIDEWAYS SWEEP strike animation of the EXACT same cute tan spotted coiled snake as references. Match rounded clay volumes, tan body with chocolate brown round spots, large black expressive eyes, warm upper-left light. EXACT canvas1536x768, FOUR columns TWO rows, eight equal384x384 cells, no lines/labels. One complete snake per cell; coiled base remains centered x208 grounded y352 in EACH cell, fixed camera and scale. Faces LEFT in ALL eight frames, never mirror direction. Read left to right then next row: 0 rest coil, 1 crouch head down, 2 low compressed S-neck, 3 tense low anticipation, 4 neck extends nearly horizontally left close above coils and mouth opens, 5 peak LOW leftward reach at height y205 mouth open one forked tongue, 6 head retracts closing mouth, 7 return rest. Do NOT raise neck high. Anchored coil base throughout, head and neck articulate naturally without moving whole body. Clearly different from upright attack in reference. Single head, continuous neck, one body and one tail; no duplicate anatomy. Complete silhouettes within x12..368 y70..352 of every cell, transparent gutters. Transparent background, no shadow plane, no checkerboard, no text, stars or speed trails.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent game power-up icon, square canvas. Generate FROM SCRATCH one curved GOLDEN FEATHER matching the reference game's rounded sculpted-clay art style and upper-left soft studio light. Reference establishes material and volume, not subject. A single warm golden ochre feather curved diagonally, chunky smooth individually sculpted barbs, raised central shaft, gentle tactile clay imperfections, warm soft highlights and visible shaded volume. Clear readable silhouette at 32 pixels. Isolated centered feather fills about80% of square. No extra feathers, no sparkles, coins, rings, text, character or background; genuine transparency, not a painted checkerboard. Avoid flat vector gradients, paper-cut illustration or photographic texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent game power-up icon, square canvas. Generate FROM SCRATCH a single emerald GREEN PROTECTIVE FEATHER matching reference game's rounded sculpted-clay material and upper-left studio light. Reference establishes material only, not bird subject. One thick curved feather pointing diagonally up-right, chunky overlapping softly bevelled clay barbs, raised lime-green central shaft, tactile matte clay surface and soft shaded volume, rich forest-green edges and lighter yellow-green center. Compact confident shield-like feather silhouette readable at32px. Centered isolated object fills80% ofsquare. No separate shield object, no extra feathers, circles, stars, text or background; real transparency. Avoid flat vector/paper cut or realistic photographic feather.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent FOUR-CELL game particle atlas. Generate FROM SCRATCH a square 2x2 grid, each quadrant containing exactly ONE isolated sculpted-clay object, matching rounded matte clay material and soft upper-left light in reference. Top-left: gently folded pink flower petal; top-right: warm cream flower petal; bottom-left: small red autumn leaf with a simple raised center vein; bottom-right: amber golden autumn leaf with same simple raised vein. Four separate objects, each centered in its quadrant at identical scale filling about65% of cell with generous transparent margin. Soft chunky forms, subtle handmade rounded edges, simple color variation, readable tiny silhouettes. No flower heads, stems beyond short leaf stalk, no photorealistic silk or thin photographic leaves, no background, no labels/grid lines, no checkerboard painted into pixels. True transparent background.
